title: The disjoint separators problem in graphs
summary: We study the disjoint separators problem in graphs, an analogue of the famous disjoint paths problem. Given a graph $G$ and four pairwise disjoint subsets of vertices $S_r$, $T_r$, $S_b$, $T_b$, we ask whether there exist an $(S_r,T_r)$-separator and an $(S_b,T_b)$-separator which are disjoint. This is equivalent to coloring the vertices in red or blue, with $S_r \cup T_r$ in red and $S_b \cup T_b$ in blue, such that there is no red $(S_r,T_r)$-path and no blue $(S_b,T_b)$-path.
